episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of leveraging YouTube for real estate lead generation, emphasizing the importance of consistency and patience. She discusses the challenges and strategies of video content creation, including hiring an editor and using scheduling tools to manage client interactions effectively.
